experimental_method: Analytical (Benson-type) gas-extraction method: degassed water equilibrated with O2 in a thermostatted equilibrator for 16-48 h, total pressure about 100 kPa measured with a Ruska quartz Bourdon manometer, Henry constants derived from uncorrected constants h via virial-corrected thermodynamic data reduction.
uncertainties_stated: Precision of the analytical method +/-0.05 per cent or less (abstract); temperature controlled within +/-0.003 K; average percentage deviation of the fit 0.039 (all 32 points).
quality_remarks: Authors describe it as high precision; agrees with Benson et al. within 0.04 per cent from 273.15 to 303.15 K. Henry constants H and Ostwald coefficients L are calculated by the authors from the measured h, flagged derived_by_authors. Temperatures on IPTS-68.
